reviews.author: sune

reviews.title: Best case yet
reviews.comment: Upgraded to this case from the original corsair 5000d. Upgrade in everyday and was so to build in.  Only thing is the cpu cables are a tight fit to go to the motherboard.  Id recommend anyone who builds in this case to get one of corsairs shift power supplys to give yourself some extra wiggle room. Also with the better airflow my cpu and gpu temps are down about 5 Celsius in the operating temps
reviews.author: Stange86
